evidence.title: Ice Ice Baby - Wikipedia
evidence.excerpt: "Ice Ice Baby" is the debut single by American rapper Vanilla Ice. Released by SBK Records, on his debut album, To the Extreme (1990), it is his best-known song and has appeared in remixed form on Platinum Underground and Vanilla Ice Is Back! A live version appears on the album Extremely Live, while a nu metal version appears on the album Hard to Swallow, under the title "Too Cold". factoids.title: A familiar bassline
factoids.content: “Ice Ice Baby” samples “Under Pressure” by Queen and David Bowie. The song’s hook draws on the bassline of the earlier track.

factoids.title: A song with many versions
factoids.content: The work “Ice Ice Baby” has been covered by artists including Faith No More and The Chipmunks. These are versions of the song, distinct from this Vanilla Ice recording.
